correctness.rationale: All vertex indicators are extreme 0/1 points. Cyclic two-site deletion counts the moment kernel exactly, a root-of-unity sum diagonalizes it, and partition-function second derivatives supply the constant eigenvalue. The strict ordering proof separately bounds the even-cycle finite-volume correction and handles odd signs; all claimed quantifiers n>=3 hold. The independent finite checker verifies the formulas for 3<=n<=16 and ordering to n=250. Risk: independent external verification not performed; finite checks alone do not imply the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Complete uniform-vertex Euclidean inertia for a natural infinite family of stable-set polytopes is a meaningful geometric invariant not recovered from face/Ehrhart counts. The nontrivial strict ordering uniquely identifies the least principal axis and classifies the maximal principal axes for both parities, with sharp asymptotic condition number 5. The result does more than restate classical independent-set counts; risk is possible implicit prior coverage by statistical-mechanics structure factors.
